status: FROZEN before any FONT-04 result exists. Do not generate, render or inspect until a method-freeze commit references this file's SHA-256.
purpose: Single-use held-out synthetic qualification population (P2) for FONT-04 production qualification only. Not for discovery, calibration or iteration.

generator.permitted_change: Add an explicit face-manifest input (this file's faces) and the extra phrases below. The change must not alter page schedule, placement, transform, degradation or damage logic. Prove this by regenerating the frozen FONT-01 corpus byte-identically with the modified generator.
generator.seed_derivation: Uses the generator's existing offsets (seed, seed+17000+i schedules, seed+31000 damage plan, seed+47000 damage rng). No other seeds are consumed.

licensing.rule: Font binaries and generated P2 pages are never committed; only hashes, manifests and compact metrics.

family_disjointness: None of these families appears in FONT-01 to FONT-03 (DejaVu, FreeSerif, C059, NimbusMonoPS, Z003, Liberation). NimbusRoman is Times-metric, like LiberationSerif: it is a related-but-unseen family, not a reused one.

evaluation_rules.single_use: Evaluate exactly once, with the frozen method and operating point. Any code or parameter change afterwards voids P2 for qualification and needs a new pre-registration (P2').
evaluation_rules.rendering: Both PDFium and Poppler, at native 200/300/600 DPI, original physical coordinates.

pass_criteria.pristine_quality: Per frequent class (>=10 P2 observations), in each renderer: candidate mean and p95 pristine error <= current default.
pass_criteria.material_defects: Blinded review under FONT_04_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md: zero identity-class defects (wrong character appearance, counter opened/closed, missing/added stroke, dot/sliver, weight/slant-class change) in the accepted sample, the rejected sample and the negative-set analogues; candidate total material-defect rate <= current default.
pass_criteria.functional: Text extraction and native search identical to current default; qpdf and OTS pass; deterministic repeat byte-identical.
pass_criteria.economy: Report distinct designs, draws per design, retired/added/net programs, font and PDF bytes. No economy threshold: economy is established on the real financial document (P3), not on P2.

evaluation_rules.no_post_hoc: No target, class, page or renderer may be excluded after P2 results are seen. Abstentions are counted by the frozen method's own rules.

amendment.reason: Code inspection before opening found that the 96 scheduled lines per DPI extended beyond the 9-inch page and were silently clipped; no P2 data exists.
amendment.change: Each DPI schedule is divided in order into three physical sheets of 32 lines; sheet k contains global lines 32k through 32k+31. Baseline is 32 + 18*(line % 32) points. Physical sheet is added to public and truth records; crops and PDF assembly use it. Full final scan bounding boxes must fit the 6-by-9-inch sheet or generation fails. All random draws, identities, global line keys and ordering remain unchanged.
amendment.carry_over: Everything else carries over verbatim, including faces, phrases, seeds, rules and criteria.
